description: PLANNED for OpenVibe.Website Connect (audience openvibe.website, owner or project scope): attach, verify or remove a custom domain for a share with POST /api/v1/domains from a domains.proposal@1. Connect delegates the DNS change to OpenVibe.Domains — the owner approves it in the Action Center, Domains writes the TXT/CNAME and answers with the applied proposal — and Connect never writes DNS itself or asks for the provider credential. Apex CNAME flattening, Cloudflare for SaaS and the certificate path are CON-2 decisions; the first proof uses a single-label openvibe.website host only.
